translations.web: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.
translations.bsb: But since he has no root, he remains for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, he quickly falls away.
translations.kjv: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.
translations.asv: yet hath he not root in himself, but endureth for a while; and when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, straightway he stumbleth.
